detailed_description: 2D-animated, painterly anime background art with soft cel-shaded figures and clean thin dark-brown line art. [Shot 1] A wide shot from inside the café at the window table, at seated eye level, looking out through the large rain-streaked café window. The dark wooden window frame borders the left and bottom edges of the frame; the glass fills the rest, rain running down it in thin bright lines and beaded drops catching the café's amber light in the lower corners. Beyond the glass, the night street runs away from the camera toward the upper right, wet asphalt reflecting blurred blue and white streetlights, dark shopfronts on the far side. In the middle distance, a little right of centre and about a fifth of the frame's height, <Subject 2> walks away from the camera along the far pavement, seen from behind, her navy duffle coat dark against the wet street, her right arm raised holding <Subject 3> open over her head, the round mustard-yellow canopy glowing as the one warm colour outside, her feet on the shining pavement. The upper third of the frame is soft dark blue sky and rain. Cold blue night outside, a faint amber reflection of the café's pendant lamp on the glass at the upper left.
